raw_response: {"diagnosis": "silver_transactions derives txn_date from ingest_ts. Each batch is ingested at 02:00 on the day after the transactions occur, so every POSTED row (4582) gets the wrong business date, and the gold daily aggregates are shifted by one day. txn_date should be the date of txn_ts, which is what the DATE_CONSISTENCY monitor checks.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.88, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
